chemistry-killer-07.title: Ing kondisi standar (STP,
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Ing kondisi standar (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol gas = 22.4 L), volume campuran gas sing kasusun saka metana ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) lan karbon dioksida ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) yaiku 11.2 L lan massane 16.4 g. Massa atom H=1, C=12, O=16 lan bilangan Avogadro yaiku $N_A$. Pira jumlah kabeh atom sing ana ing campuran gas iki?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Ing kondisi standar (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol gas = 22.4 L), volume campuran gas sing kasusun saka metana ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) lan karbon dioksida ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) yaiku 11.2 L lan massane 16.4 g. Massa atom H=1, C=12, O=16 lan bilangan Avogadro yaiku $N_A$. Pira jumlah kabeh atom sing ana ing campuran gas iki?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Tahap 1: Total mol = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Tahap 2: Massa: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Ngganti y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Tahap 3: Jumlah atom: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ 5 saben molekul → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ 3 saben molekul → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Jumlah 1.9 mol atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Jawaban: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Jawaban salah: 1.5 yaiku nilai sing nganggep kabeh CO2, 2.5 yaiku nilai sing nganggep kabeh CH4, lan 1.7 yaiku nilai sing mung ngetung 4 atom H ing CH4)

chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

Tahap 3: Jumlah atom: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ 5 saben molekul → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ 3 saben molekul → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Jumlah 1.9 mol atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Jawaban: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Jawaban salah: 1.5 yaiku nilai sing nganggep kabeh CO2, 2.5 yaiku nilai sing nganggep kabeh CH4, lan 1.7 yaiku nilai sing mung ngetung 4 atom H ing CH4)
